description: Paired-comparison prompt set. Categories over-sample the failure modes that matter for sign-off: text rendering, counting, spatial relations and anatomy. Averages hide those; category breakdowns do not.

prompts.text: A weathered wooden shop sign hanging above a cobbled street, the words 'OPEN DAILY' carved and painted in white, late afternoon light
A close-up of a paperback book cover on a desk, the title 'THE LONG SUMMER' in bold serif type, a coffee ring beside it
Exactly five green apples arranged in a row on a white marble countertop, even studio lighting
Three identical red bicycles leaning against a brick wall, seen straight on
A black cat sitting to the left of a blue ceramic vase, with a folded newspaper underneath the vase
A drone photograph of a small island with a lighthouse on its northern tip and a jetty extending south
prompts.note: Compositional layout rather than object presence

prompts.text: A potter's hands shaping wet clay on a wheel, close up, both hands fully visible, natural window light
A violinist mid-performance, fingers on the fingerboard and bow hand in motion, warm stage lighting
A misty pine forest at dawn, shafts of light between the trunks, shot on medium format film
A rain-slicked city street at night, neon reflections in the puddles, shallow depth of field
A brushed aluminium wristwatch on a dark slate surface, single softbox from the upper left, crisp specular highlights
A glass bottle of olive oil against a plain cream background, label facing forward, gentle gradient lighting
An environmental portrait of an older fisherman on a harbour wall, weathered face, overcast light, 85mm lens
A macro photograph of a dragonfly wing, individual veins and iridescence visible, shallow focus
A busy morning farmers market with stalls of citrus and flowers, several shoppers, a striped awning overhead, and a chalkboard price sign
An oil painting in the style of a nineteenth century seascape, heavy impasto, a small boat against a breaking wave
